name: @zephytiju/prism-storage-meter
description: Platform Prism storage-meter micro-UI (component id "storage-meter"): the VAULT side panel's Local Workspace section — LOCAL WORKSPACE card with synthetic-data note, quota progress bar, percent • used OF total usage line, and optional last-sync line. The quota is computed from the stored file entries read through the embedded IFileEntry client over the Prism Lattice transport (summed sizeBytes against the configured quota — NOT interface-mediated); the bar turns warn at the configured threshold and threat at 100%. Routine read — no audit events. Ships en + zh-CN locale bundles.
